summary: EN and FA leads are nearly identical in framing Zionism as a modern ethnic nationalist colonial project with explicit demographic goals and 1948 expulsion details, plus opponent critiques. AR aligns on colonization and expulsion but adds Argentina proposals and Holocaust role. HE frames it as a national liberation movement rooted in ancient Jewish history and tradition without mentioning colonization, expulsion, or critics. JA provides only a minimal definition focused on state/culture revival.
